# DH-ADOM publication audit — 2026-10-06

## Sources and naming
Reviewed the supplied 22-page PDF v1.0, the illustrated DOCX whose filename says v1.1 but whose cover says v1.0, specification, package code, templates, schemas, diagrams, conformance script and benchmark protocol. The authoritative expansion is DevHeal Hierarchical Agent Development & Orchestration Model. GH-ADOM is a prompt/folder spelling; use DH-ADOM and /dh-adom/. The supplied overview image has a different expansion and depicts planned capabilities; label it as an illustrative package concept, not a runtime screenshot.

Two supplied package layouts duplicate content. Use the numbered layout because its script paths match the actual folders. The friendly layout carries a stale manifest and script paths. Preserve original publication artifacts and publish a separately generated inventory/checksum list; omit Python caches from the distribution.

## Implementation evidence
Reference library dh-adom-reference 1.0.0 requires Python >=3.11. Registry enforces unique IDs and checks exactly one feature owner on lookup. Policy checks IDs, declared depth, steps, cost, permission subsets and exact include/exclude collisions. It does not enforce filesystem glob boundaries, observed runtime/cost, parallelism, ancestry or the full lifecycle. Specialist execute returns a deterministic COMPLETE record with no model/tool execution. Audit and registry are in memory; denied policy attempts are not logged by RootAgent. OpenAPI is an outline and has no HTTP implementation in this package. Publish these distinctions.

The implementation project has repository constitution, feature ownership manifests and policies referring to DH-ADOM, but section references exceed this paper's 24 sections. RootDaemon uses mock incident polling, and AgentEngine.execute_tool returns a string. These are not evidence of complete deployment or conformance. No unrelated product source is copied or marketed here.

## Evidence and publication boundaries
Three supplied unit tests cover routing, valid delegation and permission rejection. Seven conformance checks test file presence; the 20 requirements are not all automatically exercised. Experiment protocol/task catalog exist; comparative result datasets do not. Do not claim certification or performance superiority. No verified public registry package or dedicated public repository supplied. Publish local-source installation, not an invented pip registry command.

## Metadata, rights and assets
Paper author: Sai Narender Nuckala / DevHeal Labs AI; package release date 2026-10-06. Whitepaper cover version 1.0. Source library has an Apache-2.0 notice; publication materials have their own restrictive notice. Preserve both notices. No DOI present. Published web citation uses current .com URL while original downloads retain historical metadata. Preserve source PDF/DOCX bytes. SVGs are available and preferable to small PNG diagrams for reading.

## Implementation plan
Build overview, full HTML paper, specification, architecture, reference implementation, evaluation, security, research, downloads/citation/version pages. Add links from Research, Whitepaper, Developers, Architecture, and shared Resources navigation. Keep this an engineering method rather than another product. Generate accessible tables, reading TOC, textual formal notation, vector diagrams, download checksums and source traceability. Keep audit files under .github so deployment excludes internal review notes.
